summary: short journey summary
description: journey details

summary: Owner Creates Account and Completes Onboarding
description: New owner signs up, verifies email, completes onboarding wizard, lands on dashboard.

summary: Owner Signup — Invalid Password and Duplicate Email Blocked
description: Owner attempts signup with weak password then duplicate email. Both blocked with inline errors.

summary: Owner Connects Google Business Profile Review Link
description: Owner adds Google review link in Settings. System validates and confirms. Dashboard banner clears.

summary: Owner Attempts to Save an Invalid Google Review Link
description: Owner saves a non-Google URL. Inline validation error shown. Link not saved.

summary: Owner Sends a Single Review Request SMS
description: Owner sends SMS to customer. Preview shown. Dashboard confirms send. Activity feed updated.

summary: Owner Attempts to Send SMS to an Opted-Out Customer
description: Owner tries to send to opted-out number. System blocks with clear message. No SMS sent.

summary: Owner Attempts Duplicate SMS Send Within 30-Day Cooldown
description: Owner sends to customer already messaged 18 days ago. Cooldown detected. Send blocked.

summary: Owner Sends Bulk Review Requests via CSV Upload
description: Owner uploads CSV. Preview shows valid and invalid rows. Confirms send. Progress shown.

summary: Bulk CSV Upload — Invalid File Format and Oversized List
description: Owner uploads CSV with missing headers then 510-row file. Both rejected with clear errors.

summary: Happy Customer Rates 5 Stars and is Redirected to Google
description: Customer taps link, rates 5 stars, sees Google prompt, taps button, taken to Google.

summary: Unhappy Customer Rates 2 Stars and Submits Private Feedback
description: Customer taps 2 stars, sees private feedback form, submits text. Owner sees new feedback badge.

summary: Unhappy Customer Skips Private Feedback Text
description: Customer rates 2 stars, skips feedback form. Outcome recorded as skipped. Not directed to Google.

summary: Owner Receives Real-Time Notification for Negative Feedback
description: Owner sees new 1-star feedback notification. Verifies event stored via API.

summary: Customer Opts Out via STOP and Owner Cannot Override
description: Customer replies STOP. Opt-out recorded. Owner sees number in opted-out list. Cannot remove.

summary: Expired Review Link Clicked by Customer
description: Customer clicks 30-day-expired link. Expired state shown. No rating, no Google redirect.

summary: Owner Reviews Dashboard Summary and Activity Feed
description: Owner sees 4 metric cards with trend indicators and recent activity feed in reverse order.

summary: Owner Reads and Responds to Private Feedback
description: Owner sees unread badge, expands feedback, adds note, reveals phone, marks resolved.

summary: Owner Searches and Filters Customer List
description: Owner searches customer by name, filters by opted-out status, views detail, adds note.

summary: Owner Customises SMS Template
description: Owner edits template with variables. Character counter and live preview update. Saved.

summary: Owner Attempts to Save SMS Template Without Mandatory Variables
description: Owner removes [ReviewLink] and [FirstName]. Both blocked. STOP instruction auto-appended.

summary: Owner Updates Business Profile and Logo
description: Owner updates name, suburb, logo, account name, password. Unsaved changes dialog shown.

summary: Owner Invites and Revokes a Staff Member
description: Growth owner invites staff member, confirms in list, revokes access. Staff immediately removed.

summary: Starter Plan Owner Sees Staff Invite Blocked with Upgrade Prompt
description: Starter owner sees disabled Invite Staff. Upgrade prompt shown. No invite form displayed.

summary: Owner Connects Google Account via OAuth
description: Seeded OAuth connection. Owner sees connected email and disconnect option in settings.

summary: Google OAuth Connected Account Has No Business Profile Access
description: Seeded OAuth with no real data. Dashboard shows error or empty Google Reviews card.

summary: Owner Triggers Manual Google Review Sync
description: Owner with connected Google account triggers manual sync. Card updates with result.

summary: Owner Replies to a Google Review from Inside Zovku
description: Owner finds unreplied review, types reply, posts. Success confirmation shown.

summary: Happy Customer Is Offered AI-Drafted Google Review Text
description: Customer rates 5 stars. AI suggestion shown. Copy and regenerate buttons present.

summary: AI Review Writing Unavailable — Happy Fork Continues Unaffected
description: AI unavailable. No error shown to customer. Google Review button still present and functional.

summary: Owner Connects Facebook and TripAdvisor for Multi-Platform Monitoring
description: SKIPPED: no test seeding endpoint for Facebook/TripAdvisor OAuth.

summary: Growth Feature Blocked on Starter Plan — Multi-Platform Monitoring
description: SKIPPED: no test seeding endpoint for Facebook/TripAdvisor OAuth.

summary: New Owner Experiences 14-Day Free Trial
description: Trial owner sees countdown banner. Full Starter features accessible. SMS send not blocked.

summary: Suspended Account — Trial Expired Without Payment
description: Suspended owner sees suspension message. SMS send blocked. Reactivation via set-plan tested.

summary: Owner Subscribes to Starter Plan via Stripe Checkout
description: Subscribe button present and links to Stripe. Post-payment active state asserted via set-plan.

summary: Stripe Checkout — Card Declined on Subscription
description: SKIPPED: cannot automate Stripe Checkout UI card decline flow.

summary: Owner Cancels Subscription Without Friction
description: Cancellation simulated via webhook. Billing page shows cancelled state with access end date.

summary: Owner Views Invoice History and Downloads PDF
description: Seeded invoice appears in billing history. Download button present. NZ$49 Paid status shown.

summary: Failed Payment Handled with Grace Period and Recovery
description: Payment failed simulated. In-app banner shown. Recovery simulated. Banner clears.

summary: Owner Reactivates Subscription After Cancellation
description: Cancellation then reactivation simulated. Active state restored. Cancellation message cleared.

summary: Owner Sends Review Request via Email Channel
description: Owner sends email review request. Success confirmed. Activity feed updated.

summary: Email Review Request Blocked by 30-Day Cooldown
description: Email request sent to customer already in cooldown window. Second send blocked.
